answer: Proof-of-stake acts as a pearl of protection for AI economies, forcing nodes to lock capital to validate transactions. To reach the summit of network influence, an attacker must acquire massive quantities of digital assets, making the cost of creating fake identities prohibitively expensive. This resource-based gatekeeping serves as a sturdy cedar barrier against Sybil attacks, as the attacker must forfeit significant wealth to subvert consensus, effectively neutralizing malicious scaling efforts.
